mapper.select: SELECT emp_id FROM emp WHERE emp_no = #{empNo}
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO payslip p USING (SELECT #{empId} emp_id, #{yyyymm} apply_yyyymm, #{payType} pay_type FROM dual) x ON (p.emp_id = x.emp_id AND p.apply_yyyymm = x.apply_yyyymm AND p.pay_type = x.pay_type) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (payslip_id, emp_id, pay_type, apply_yyyymm, net_pay_amt) VALUES (SEQ_PAYSLIP.NEXTVAL, x.emp_id, x.pay_type, x.apply_yyyymm, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT NVL(SUM(i.amount),0) FROM payslip_item i WHERE i.payslip_id = #{payslipId}
SELECT NVL(SUM(d.amount),0) FROM payslip_deduction d WHERE d.payslip_id = #{payslipId}

jdbcType=NUMERIC}, t.tax_adjust_rate), t.project_name = NVL(#{f.projectName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, t.project_name), t.tax_calc_exempt_yn = NVL(#{f.taxCalcExemptYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, t.tax_calc_exempt_yn), t.prorate_yn = NVL(#{f.prorateYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, t.prorate_yn), t.settlement_reflect_yn = NVL(#{f.settlementReflectYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, t.settlement_reflect_yn), t.manuf_tax_exempt_yn = NVL(#{f.manufTaxExemptYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, t.manuf_tax_exempt_yn), t.overseas_tax_exempt_yn = NVL(#{f.overseasTaxExemptYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, t.overseas_tax_exempt_yn), t.researcher_tax_exempt_yn = NVL(#{f.researcherTaxExemptYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, t.researcher_tax_exempt_yn), t.income_tax_reduction_rate = NVL(#{f.incomeTaxReductionRate, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, t.income_tax_reduction_rate), t.personal_tax_apply_type = NVL(#{f.personalTaxApplyType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, t.personal_tax_apply_type), t.bonus_rate = NVL(#{f.bonusRate, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, researcher_tax_exempt_yn, income_tax_reduction_rate, personal_tax_apply_type, bonus_rate) VALUES (seq_etp.NEXTVAL, #{empId}, NVL(#{f.taxAdjustRate, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, NULL), NVL(#{f.projectName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NULL), NVL(#{f.taxCalcExemptYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N'), NVL(#{f.prorateYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N'), NVL(#{f.settlementReflectYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N'), NVL(#{f.manufTaxExemptYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N'), NVL(#{f.overseasTaxExemptYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N'), NVL(#{f.researcherTaxExemptYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N'), NVL(#{f.incomeTaxReductionRate, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, NULL), NVL(#{f.personalTaxApplyType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NULL), NVL(#{f.bonusRate, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, NULL) )

MERGE INTO pay_month_summary s USING ( SELECT #{payType} AS pay_type, #{yyyymm} AS apply_yyyymm, NVL(SUM(i.amount),0) AS total_pay_amt, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN i.is_previous = 'Y' THEN i.amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS prev_paid_amt, NVL(SUM(d.amount),0) AS total_ded_amt, NVL(SUM(i.amount),0) - NVL(SUM(d.amount),0) AS net_pay_amt FROM payslip p LEFT JOIN payslip_item i ON i.payslip_id = p.payslip_id LEFT JOIN payslip_deduction d ON d.payslip_id = p.payslip_id WHERE p.apply_yyyymm = #{yyyymm} AND p.pay_type = #{payType} ) x ON (s.pay_type = x.pay_type AND s.apply_yyyymm = x.apply_yyyymm) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET s.total_pay_amt = x.total_pay_amt, s.prev_paid_amt = x.prev_paid_amt, s.total_ded_amt = x.total_ded_amt, s.net_pay_amt = x.net_pay_amt WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (pay_month_id, pay_type, apply_yyyymm, total_pay_amt, prev_paid_amt, total_ded_amt, net_pay_amt) VALUES (seq_pms.NEXTVAL, x.pay_type, x.apply_yyyymm, x.total_pay_amt, x.prev_paid_amt, x.total_ded_amt, x.net_pay_amt)
UPDATE emp SET retire_date = CASE WHEN #{retiredYn} = 'Y' THEN LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(#{yyyymm}||'-01','YYYY-MM-DD')) ELSE NULL END WHERE emp_id = #{empId}

MERGE INTO pay_month_summary s USING ( SELECT #{payType} pay_type, #{yyyymm} apply_yyyymm, #{totalPayAmt} total_pay_amt, #{prevPaidAmt} prev_paid_amt, #{totalDedAmt} total_ded_amt, #{netPayAmt} net_pay_amt FROM dual ) x ON (s.pay_type = x.pay_type AND s.apply_yyyymm = x.apply_yyyymm) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET s.total_pay_amt = x.total_pay_amt, s.prev_paid_amt = x.prev_paid_amt, s.total_ded_amt = x.total_ded_amt, s.net_pay_amt = x.net_pay_amt WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (pay_month_id, pay_type, apply_yyyymm, total_pay_amt, prev_paid_amt, total_ded_amt, net_pay_amt) VALUES (SEQ_PAY_MONTH.NEXTVAL, x.pay_type, x.apply_yyyymm, x.total_pay_amt, x.prev_paid_amt, x.total_ded_amt, x.net_pay_amt)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM pay_voucher v WHERE v.summary_note = #{token}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pay_voucher (voucher_id, voucher_no, pay_date, summary_note, approved_yn) VALUES ( SEQ_PAY_VOUCHER.NEXTVAL, NULL, LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(#{yyyymm}||'-01','YYYY-MM-DD')), #{token}, 'N' )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM payslip_deduction WHERE payslip_id = #{payslipId} AND deduction_code IN ('TAX_INCOME','TAX_LOCAL')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payslip_deduction (pd_id, payslip_id, deduction_code, deduction_name, amount) VALUES (SEQ_PAYSLIP_DEDUCTION.NEXTVAL, #{payslipId}, #{code}, #{name}, #{amount})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT y.emp_id, y.base_year, /* TODO: 실제 환급/추징 금액 산식은 yrt_result_total 등으로 확장 */ 0 AS refund_amt, 0 AS additional_tax_amt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY y.emp_id ORDER BY y.created_at DESC) rn FROM yrt_header y WHERE y.emp_id = #{empId} AND y.base_year = #{baseYear} ) t WHERE t.rn = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payslip_item (item_id, payslip_id, is_previous, is_safety_bonus, item_name, amount) VALUES (SEQ_PAYSLIP_ITEM.NEXTVAL, #{payslipId}, 'N', 'N', #{itemName}, #{amount})
INSERT INTO payslip_deduction (pd_id, payslip_id, deduction_code, deduction_name, amount) VALUES (SEQ_PAYSLIP_DEDUCTION.NEXTVAL, #{payslipId}, #{code}, #{name}, #{amount})
